description: Machine-readable inventory of every medically relevant condition currently represented in production code. Generated by the Task #133 reconnaissance; maintained by the AfflictionInventoryDriftTests source gate.

progression_owners.documented_order: Within campaign phase 3, owners tick in ordinal id order: duty_roster, medical_disease (scheduled procedures -> chemical dependency -> disease), phase0_psychology (respiratory, radiation sickness, trauma, flashbacks, guilt), survivor_social, survivors_needs (needs, radiation dose).

afflictions.onset_rules: ash exposure rate 0.5/h in fallout storm (x2 if filter < 50), 0.25/h in ash zone, 2/day indoors with failing filter
afflictions.terminal_rules: terminal event at >= 95 (OnTerminalLungDamage); death stays with SurvivorFateSystem
afflictions.ui_representation: MedicalPanel lung row (raw % until Task #133 cutover, then patient record)

afflictions.severity_representation: discrete phases (Healthy/Prodromal/Latent/ManifestIllness/ChronicFibrosis/RecoveryOrDeath) + rolling acute-dose window + permanent latent damage
afflictions.progression_owner: phase0_psychology day owner -> RadiationPhase.Tick; dose ticks in survivors_needs -> RadiationSystem.Tick
afflictions.onset_rules: acute dose window >= 100 triggers Prodromal; RadiationSystem acute threshold 80
afflictions.diagnosis_representation: DiagnosisKnowledgeStore episode (auto-suspect on phase change); DoseLedger bookings are measurements, not diagnoses
afflictions.recovery_rules: RecoveryOrDeath phase resolution owned by RadiationPhaseProgression
afflictions.relapse_rules: chronic fibrosis / chronic illness are permanent flags
afflictions.chronic_state_rules: LatentDamage never decays; chronic illness grant at >= 100
afflictions.terminal_rules: OnTerminalPrognosisDeclared -> final wish; death via lethal health loss through fate pipeline

afflictions.diagnosis_representation: always visible (needs are player-facing by design)

afflictions.progression_owner: medical_disease day owner -> MedicalHostSession.TickHours -> Engine.TickHours (Phase-0 no longer ticks shared instance)
afflictions.diagnosis_representation: always visible (ledger is player-facing by design; the diagnosis knowledge store plays no role)
afflictions.relapse_rules: re-consumption re-forms dependency after clean decay
afflictions.save_representation: medical_save.json (canonical) + chemical_dependency_save.json (kept in sync from shared engine)
afflictions.ui_representation: MedicalPanel dependency ledger + ChemicalDependencyPanel (detox starts via pipeline preview/execute with the selected substance)
afflictions.pipeline_status: migrated_write_path (P1b: detox starts via the pipeline with targetItem substance selection; ChemicalDependencySystem keeps both withdrawal clocks and TickHours remains the only clock — no MedicalProcedureSchedule entry)

afflictions.severity_representation: days_sick counter per infection + outbreak flags
afflictions.diagnosis_representation: DiagnosisKnowledgeStore episode (auto-suspect on infection and on restored active infections; identity masked until an explicit identify confirms it)
afflictions.ui_representation: MedicalPanel disease ward section (masked rows + isolate/release/protocol actions); DiseaseHostSession snapshots remain headless/CLI only
afflictions.pipeline_status: migrated_write_path (P1: quarantine/release + camp-wide vector protocols via pipeline, consuming authored countermeasure items; DiseaseSystem keeps every progression rule and TickDaily remains the only clock)
observe_only_projection (P1c: PatientRecord rows via CombatTraumaAfflictionHandler; no pipeline treatments — the handler always refuses; Phase-0 keeps the tick and every rule)
observe_only_projection (P1c: PatientRecord rows via SomaticFlashbackAfflictionHandler; FLASHBACK stage while hours remain, else SUSCEPTIBLE; no pipeline treatments; Phase-0 keeps the tick)

observe_only_projection (P1c: PatientRecord rows via GuiltInsomniaAfflictionHandler; INSOMNIA / CRITICAL INSOMNIA stages; no pipeline treatments — sedatives and dialogue stay outside the pipeline; Phase-0 keeps the tick)

afflictions.diagnosis_representation: SickListSystem.Diagnose is an explicit clinical naming act
afflictions.pipeline_status: not migrated (measurement authority; sick-list naming is the existing diagnosis path)

not_modeled.wounds_bleeding_fractures: No wound/bleeding/fracture system exists in production; CombatTraumaSystem is hypervigilance only. Not invented by Task #133.
not_modeled.diagnostic_minigame: No hidden-knowledge minigame exists; Task #133 adds Unknown/Suspected/Confirmed knowledge without changing domain truth.
not_modeled.medical_staff_competence: No staff skill gates exist in medical code; not invented.
